action 12 (click): clicked stage_road/lamp at world 640,623 -- SPEAK TO HOB, WHICH IS THE STEP THE ROUTE NEVER HAD. Beat 9 declares awaitFlag T_HOB_SPOKEN, so Hob stands at the roadside with his lamp until he is addressed -- Q63, ruled: 'Hob stands in the gap, and clearing him is the way out.' He is a MOVER with no rect (Q60), so the lamp he carries is the only part of him a player can click, and every response on it writes the flag. Until this click, beat 9 never plays, beat 10 never sets T_HOB_GONE, and road_west stays shut for ever.
